description: React component for a full-screen modal with animations, focus management, and accessibility features.

classes.name: FullScreenModal
classes.description: A React component implementing a full-screen modal with accessibility and animation features.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for keydown and focus when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners when component unmounts.

methods.name: enforceFocus
methods.description: Ensures the modal retains focus when active.

methods.name: handleKeypress
methods.description: Handles keypress events, particularly the Escape key to close the modal.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Triggers the onClose callback to close the modal.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with transition, focus management, and accessibility attributes.
